Title: How to do a partial trace over registers (rather than individual qubits) in Qiskit

In Qiskit, is the partial_trace function able to do a partial trace over registers, as opposed to over individual qubits? In the code example below, I have four registers (reg1 thru reg4) and I am trying to call partial_trace with a list of register to trace out. This does not work; the code throws the following exception: Note: I know how to do a partial trace over individual qubits (see for example this question or this question. I am asking specifically how to trace out entire registers rather than individual qubits. The code:

from qiskit import Aer, QuantumCircuit, QuantumRegister, transpile from qiskit.quantum_info import partial_trace qc = QuantumCircuit() reg1 = QuantumRegister(2) qc.add_register(reg1) reg2 = QuantumRegister(2) qc.add_register(reg2) reg3 = QuantumRegister(2) qc.add_register(reg3) reg4 = QuantumRegister(2) qc.add_register(reg4) # It's not relevant to the question what exactly is done in the circuit qc.h(reg1[0]) qc.cnot(reg1[0], reg2[0]) qc.h(reg3[0]) qc.x(reg4[0]) qc.cnot(reg3[0], reg4[0]) simulator = Aer.get_backend("aer_simulator") qc.save_statevector() transpiled_qc = transpile(qc, simulator) result = simulator.run(transpiled_qc).result() traced_over_registers = [reg2, reg4 ] density_matrix = partial_trace(result.get_statevector(), traced_over_registers)
